name: hotkey-translate
description: Chrome extension to translate selected text and hear its pronunciation with keyboard shortcuts.

scripts.package: V=$(node -p "require('./manifest.json').version") && mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/hotkey-translate-$V.zip && zip -r -X dist/hotkey-translate-$V.zip manifest.json background.js settings.js offscreen.html offscreen.js popup.html popup.js _locales icons -x "*.DS_Store"
